title: New fire sparks west of Spokane, prompting brief evacuation order
description: A fourth wildfire sparked Wednesday afternoon west of Spokane, prompting a brief and relatively minor evacuation notice as crews scrambled to contain the flames.
content:
A fourth wildfire sparked Wednesday afternoon in the Spokane area, prompting a brief evacuation notice as crews scrambled to contain the flames west of town. Crews quickly stopped the spread.
